selection_rationale: Use an operational manual-review budget of approximately five percent on the validation distribution. The threshold is derived only from precomputed validation predictions.

decision_logic.INVALID_INPUT: Handled separately by application input validation.

score_interpretation: Softmax outputs are model scores and are not presented as guaranteed calibrated probabilities.
limitations: Validation contained zero classification errors, so no empirical correct-versus-incorrect error boundary could be estimated.
High-confidence errors may not be detected by confidence-based review rules.
OOD inputs may still receive high softmax scores because the classifier is closed-set.
